title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I want to change my name 1938 views Q. My wife is expecting. She would be delivering in a few days. I have heard that if a person makes niyat that he would name the newborn as Muhammad, then he would be gifted with a son. I had decided in my mind that Insha Allah I would name my first born "Muhammad Imdadullah", with due to respect to the prophet SAS and love for the saint Haji Imdadullah Makki (RAH). But on consulting an aalim, he has said that the name is a mismatch. I'm in a predicament, whether I can add Haji sahab's name to the name Muhammad or not? Please guide me. 2802 views Q. Give me some name of Sahaba (Raziullah Anah) for my son. Except 10 sahaba of Ashra Mubashra. because that names are already exist. as soon as possibe. JAZAKALLAH 4054 views Q. I am expecting a baby very soon. So I want to know whether it is permissible to keep the fathers name next to the childrens' name for e.g. Ammara Imran or Talha Imran 1943 views Q. Assalmualaikum, I want the meaning of the names: (1) Basheer ahmad, a boy name & (2) Nida ,a girl name. Remember me in dua. 2182 views Q. Please suggest me Islamic names like Quranic names, Prophet, Sahaba, Sahabiya, Tabayeen etc. 9209 views Q. Please could you confirm the name 'Maseeha' is acceptable for a muslim girl and what does the name mean. 5071 views Q. اصفا فاطمہ (Aasfa fathima) نام کے بارے میں بتائیں۔کیا یہ نام شریعت کی روشنی میں درست ہے؟براہ کرم، کوئی ایسا نام بتائیں جو بہت زیادہ اچھا ہو اور اس کے بہت سارے فضائل ہوں۔ میں اپنی بیٹی کا نام رکھنا چاہتاہوں جو کل پیدا ہوئی ہے۔ 1764 views Q. My name chandsab. Some People From My place are telling that this is not a name in islam you should chnge your name is necessary for me to change my name. Is islam Name have any thing to do with islam Please explain me if it is necessary please suggest me a Good name. My Fathers Name is Rajasab. 1819 views Q. میں نے اپنے بیٹوں کے نام احمد مصطفی اور محمد رکھا ہے، کیا یہ درست ہے؟ 1778 views Q. نام ” ایان “ کے معنی بتائیں ؟ اور کیا یہ اچھا نام ہے؟ 3864 views Q. Can I name my son Muhammad Shehzar.I read on a wbsite that Persian names that have no Islamic origin should not be given to muslims? 2071 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 2023 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Is it Haram, Makrouh, or permissible to name my son as Michelle or daughter as Suzzane? Question: Is it Haram, Makrouh, or permissible to name my son as Michelle or daughter as Suzzane? Answer ID: 2023 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1388/1228=B) These names are from any other language and resemble the names of non-Muslims; they are not Islamic names. It is not right to follow the way of non-Muslim people. Naming after the prophets and sahaba is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
